mapper.select: SELECT emp.employee_id as employee_id, emp.employee_name as employee_name, emp.age as age, emp.gender as gender, emp.post_no as post_no, emp.address as address, emp.tel as tel, emp.dept_id as dept_id, emp.role_id as role_id, emp.ad_regist_flg as ad_regist_flg, emp.note as note, dep.dept_name as dept_name, rol.role_name as role_name, lang.lang_id as lang_id, lang.lang_name as lang_name FROM demo.employees emp INNER JOIN demo.depts dep ON( emp.dept_id = dep.dept_id AND dep.delete_flg='0' ) INNER JOIN demo.roles rol ON(emp.role_id = rol.role_id) INNER JOIN demo.program_langs lang ON(emp.employee_id = lang.employee_id) WHERE emp.delete_flg = '0' AND emp.employee_id = #{employeeId};
